entry.title: The Same Place — Robocalls, Spam Texts, Political Ads, Sports Betting, and the FCC That Lets It Happen
entry.content:
It All Comes From the Same Place

Your phone rings. Robocall. You decline.

Your phone buzzes. Political text. “Vote YES on Prop X.” You didn’t sign up.

Your phone buzzes again. Sports betting. “LIONS +3.5 — BET NOW.” You didn’t ask.

Three interruptions. Three industries. One infrastructure.

The Pipeline

FORTUNE 500 / NASDAQ
    │
    ├── DraftKings (NASDAQ: DKNG) ──────────────────────┐
    │   Revenue: $3.7B (2025)                            │
    │   Lobbied for MI sports betting legalization        │
    │   (HB 4311, signed Dec 2019)                       │
    │                                                    │
    ├── Flutter/FanDuel (NYSE: FLUT) ───────────────────┤
    │   Revenue: $14.8B (2025)                           │
    │   Lobbied alongside DraftKings                     │
    │                                                    │
    ├── MGM Resorts (NYSE: MGM) / BetMGM ──────────────┤
    │   Revenue: $17.1B (2025)                           │
    │   Detroit casino operator + online sports book     │
    │                                                    │── ALL USE SAME
    ├── Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) ──────────────────┤   DIGITAL AD
    │   Revenue: $164B (2025)                            │   INFRASTRUCTURE
    │   Political ad platform + sports betting ads       │
    │   (see: Meta's Two Faces)                          │
    │                                                    │
    ├── Alphabet/Google (NASDAQ: GOOGL) ────────────────┤
    │   Revenue: $350B (2025)                            │
    │   Political ad platform + sports betting ads       │
    │                                                    │
    ├── AT&T (NYSE: T) ────────────────────────────────┤
    │   Revenue: $122B (2025)                            │── CARRIER NETWORK
    │   Carries the robocalls + texts                    │   (pipes)
    │                                                    │
    ├── T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) ───────────────────────┤
    │   Revenue: $80B (2025)                             │
    │   Carries the robocalls + texts                    │
    │                                                    │
    └── Dykema Gossett PLLC ───────────────────────────┘
        Michigan's largest law firm                      
        Formed Save Detroit Jobs (dark money)            
        Operates Federal PAC (C00342113, $158K+)         
        80+ client accounts managed by Renae Moore       
        7+ political vehicles formed by W. Alan Wilk     
        Same firm. Same compliance email.                
        compliance@dykema.com

How It Works

Step 1: Legalize the Product

Sports betting was illegal in Michigan until December 2019. DraftKings, FanDuel, and MGM lobbied the Michigan legislature to pass HB 4311 (Lawful Sports Betting Act).

The same legislature where Brian Banks ran for State Senate. The same legislature where Lee Chatfield (Speaker, now facing 13 felonies) controlled the calendar. The same legislature where Dykema Gossett operates the largest political compliance operation in the state.

Step 2: Build the Ad Machine

Once legal, sports betting companies spent billions on advertising:

CompanyAnnual US Ad SpendPlatform
DraftKings~$1BTV, digital, text, push notifications
FanDuel~$800MTV, digital, text, push notifications
BetMGM~$500MTV, digital, text, push notifications

These ads run through Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google (YouTube/Search), and carrier networks (AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon) as push notifications and texts.

Step 3: Use the Same Infrastructure for Politics

The digital ad platforms don’t distinguish between:

  • A DraftKings ad (“BET THE LIONS”)
  • A political PAC ad (“VOTE FOR X”)
  • A robocall from a dark money group

They all use the same targeting data, the same delivery networks, and the same billing infrastructure.

DeliveryMeta/Google/carrierMeta/Google/carrierVoIP/carrier
BillingCorporate treasuryPAC/dark moneyUntraceable prepaid

Step 4: Dark Money Funds Both Sides

Dykema Gossett operates:

State PACMI filingFund state candidates$725K+ since 2017

The same law firm that lobbied for sports betting legalization also runs the dark money pipeline that elects the officials who oversee the schools, the police, and the courts.

The Michigan Connection

Michigan is ground zero because:

  1. Battleground state — massive political ad spend every cycle
  2. Sports betting legalized 2019 — DraftKings/FanDuel HQ’d their MI operations
  3. Three Detroit casinos — MGM Grand Detroit, MotorCity, Greektown (all now have sports books)
  4. Dykema Gossett HQ — Lansing and Detroit offices, largest law firm in the state
  5. Chatfield indictment — the Speaker who controlled the legislative calendar now faces 13 felonies. Dykema’s Renae Moore managed 80+ of his compliance accounts.

The political ads, the sports betting ads, and the robocalls all start in Michigan and radiate outward through the same corporate infrastructure.

The Fortune 500 / NASDAQ Trail

Every entity in this pipeline is publicly traded or connected to a publicly traded company:

CompanyTickerMarket CapRole in Pipeline

AlphabetNASDAQ: GOOGL~$2.2TAd platform + search indexing
DraftKingsNASDAQ: DKNG~$20BSports betting ads flooding your phone

T-MobileNASDAQ: TMUS~$260BCarrier that delivers the texts
MicrosoftNASDAQ: MSFT~$3.1TPolitical ad infrastructure (LinkedIn)

Combined market cap: ~$7.4 TRILLION.

Seven point four trillion dollars of corporate infrastructure delivering robocalls, spam texts, political ads, and sports betting notifications to your phone. All using the same pipes. All using the same targeting data. All started in the same place.

The Same Place

YOUR PHONE
    ↑
    │ robocall (political)

    │ targeted ad (all of the above)
    │

THE SAME PLACE:

    + Dykema Gossett compliance office

The robocall that interrupted your dinner and the dark money mailer that elected the council member who sits on a convicted felon’s school board came from the same place.

The sports betting ad that knows your team and the political text that knows your district use the same targeting data.

The Fortune 500 company that runs the ad platform and the law firm that runs the dark money PAC share the same infrastructure.

It all comes from the same place. The membrane sees it. The graph records it. The count is the truth.

The Double Standard

The FCC is supposed to protect you from unsolicited contact. The Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA, 47 U.S.C. § 227) makes robocalls and unsolicited texts illegal without consent.

But:

WhoWhat They DidConsequence
DraftKingsSends unsolicited sports betting texts to millionsNone. FCC has not acted.
Political PACsSends unsolicited political texts (exempt from TCPA)Legal. Political speech exemption.
Robocallers50 billion robocalls/year in the US$500M in fines (since 2015) but collection rate is <1%
Dark money groupsSend mailers, fund digital ads, no disclosure requiredLegal. Citizens United.
Kevin MokSent a 9-line to 22 lawful channels documenting a public school fraud with 9 convictions, $4.9M in public money, 3% math proficiencyIGNORED by 18 of 22.

The $7.4 trillion corporate infrastructure can reach your phone whenever it wants. One person sending documented evidence of public corruption through lawful channels gets silence.

Who Responded (and Who Didn’t)

Person / AgencyWhat Kevin SentResponseTime
Nikki Snyder (SBE)Full evidence packageResponded with personal cell in 13 minutes13 min
JTC ClerkJudicial misconduct evidenceAcknowledged, merged into investigationsDays
MDESchool operator credential concernsAcknowledgedDays
USPS OIGMail fraud evidenceAcknowledgedDays
FBIRICO pattern with 6 predicate actsSILENCE46+ days
DOJFederal prosecution referralSILENCE46+ days
AG Dana NesselHer own AAG sits on the boardSILENCE30+ days
All 7 other SBE membersSame package Snyder gotSILENCE21+ days
Brian BanksDirect notice of investigationSILENCE30+ days

Nikki Snyder read the email and responded in thirteen minutes. With her personal cell number. Because she’s a nurse, an EMU grad, a mom with kids in public schools, a disability advocate. She saw the data and she ACTED.

Seven other SBE members got the same email. Same data. Same evidence. Same 3% math proficiency. Same 9 convictions. Silence.

Brian Banks got direct notice. The man with 9 criminal convictions running schools with 3% math and $4.9M in public money. Silence.

But DraftKings can text you about the Lions game. A PAC you never heard of can text you about a candidate. A robocaller can interrupt your dinner. $7.4 trillion says they have more right to your attention than a documented investigation of public corruption has to theirs.

The FCC Failure

LawWhat It SaysWhat Actually Happens
TCPA (1991)No unsolicited calls/texts without consent50B robocalls/year. Collection rate <1%.
Do Not Call Registry (2003)Register to stop telemarketingPolitical calls exempt. Scammers ignore it.
STIR/SHAKEN (2020)Authenticate caller ID to prevent spoofingCarriers slow-rolled implementation. Still spoofed.
FCC finesUp to $10K per violation$500M assessed. <$10M collected. 98% uncollectable.

The FCC has the authority. The TCPA has the teeth. But enforcement is a rounding error against the volume. 50 billion robocalls a year. The FCC fines them. They don’t pay. They spin up new LLCs. Same infrastructure. Same place.

Meanwhile: one person sends 22 documented evidence packets through lawful channels. The institutions that are SUPPOSED to respond — the ones with the legal DUTY to investigate — say nothing.

The unsolicited contact flows freely in one direction. Corporate to citizen: unlimited. Citizen to institution: ignored.

The robocall and the dark money mailer and the sports betting ad all come from the same place. The same Fortune 500 boardrooms. The same NASDAQ tickers. The same law firm in Lansing. The same compliance email. The membrane sees them all. Same pattern. Same pipeline. Same place.

But Nikki Snyder answered in 13 minutes. One person. One nurse. One mom. She saw the data and she acted. That’s the difference between a human and an institution. The human search never ends.

The Signal Ledger

One person. Sending signal since August 2026. To every lawful channel that exists.

This is not a narrative. This is a LEDGER. Every line resolves to a date, a recipient, and a response status. Verify it yourself.

The 9-Line

The signal format is GTA 08-01-004 MEDEVAC — the military standard for calling in a medical evacuation. You use it when someone is bleeding and the bird needs to get in the air. The format forces structured, unambiguous communication:

Brian Roderick Banks — 9 Criminal Convictions:

  1. Carrying Concealed Weapon
  2. Assault & Battery

  4. Probation Violation
  5. Domestic Violence (2nd offense)

  7. Disorderly Conduct

Operating 2 charter schools. ~400 children per year. 97% not proficient in math. His LLC takes 72.67% of $4.9M/year in public funds.

Verify: Michigan ICHAT — Search: Brian Roderick Banks. It takes fifteen seconds.

I. Federal Signal — 243-Page Packet to 8 Agencies (Sep 21–25, 2026)

Every agency below received the same 243-page evidence package: criminal history, entity structure, financial self-dealing, judicial connections, BMF lineage, campaign finance violations, RICO predicate acts.

IV. The Mathematics of Silence

Tit for Tat — Axelrod’s Tournament

In Robert Axelrod’s iterated prisoner’s dilemma tournament (1984), the winning strategy is Tit for Tat:

  1. Start by cooperating. Always.
  2. Mirror what the other player does. If they cooperate, cooperate. If they defect, defect.
  3. Forgive immediately. If they return to cooperation, you return to cooperation.

Kevin cooperated first. Every signal was cooperation — using lawful channels, providing evidence, offering to work together (“I am not your enemy”), providing contact information, waiting for response.

The institutions defected. Not by attacking — by choosing SILENCE.

Null ≠ Parasite… Until It Does

In biology, null means UNKNOWN — default to cooperation. A commensal takes without harming. A mutualist gives back.

But there is a threshold. When signal has been sent through EVERY lawful channel, to EVERY oversight body, with 243 pages of evidence, and the response is NULL across every channel — null becomes data.

The null is no longer “we haven’t observed behavior.” The null is observed behavior. The behavior is: received evidence of a 9-time convicted felon operating schools, and did nothing.

14 channels. 243 pages each. 21+ days. NULL.

At what point does institutional silence become institutional complicity?

V. What the ecoPrimals Graph Shows

After that date, every channel that received evidence and returned NULL gets reclassified. Not as parasite — as documented institutional failure. The null becomes the record. The silence becomes the evidence.

The graph doesn’t stop growing. It just stops waiting.

VIII. To the People Reading This in Silence

1,006 of you cloned this repository. 475 of you in a single day. You download 92 MB of court records, read them offline, and leave no trace. That’s fine. Silence is how you learn.

But the institutions had their chance. 14 channels. 243 pages. 46 days. The signal went out on a 9-LINE — the format you use when someone is bleeding and the bird needs to get in the air.

entry.title: Institutional Response Tracker
entry.content:
From Courts to Checkpoints

The Anderson Localization analysis showed that captured judges create disorder in the judicial lattice. Cases that enter cannot propagate to a fair hearing.

But courts are not the only institutional checkpoint. Michigan has layered accountability structures: credentialing bodies, oversight commissions, authorizers, professional discipline departments, and law enforcement agencies. Each exists to catch what the others miss.

The question this page answers: When the same verified evidence is submitted to multiple institutional checkpoints simultaneously, which ones act and which ones don’t?

The answer reveals whether the accountability system functions or whether the disorder extends beyond the courts into the institutions designed to oversee them.

The Model

Every institutional checkpoint is a lattice site. Evidence arrives like an electron. Either the institution transmits it forward (investigation, action, referral) or it absorbs and traps it (closure, dismissal, non-response).

If every checkpoint absorbs, the system is fully localized. No accountability can propagate.

The measurement is simple:

InputWhat Was Submitted
SubjectBrian Roderick Banks: 9 criminal convictions (SID 2029469K), unauthorized use of “J.D.” credential, operation of two DPSCD-authorized charter schools
EvidenceICHAT criminal record, LARA corporate filings, MOECS credential audit, academic performance data (3% math proficiency), financial records ($4.9M revenue, 72.67% extraction to Purpose Group LLC), campaign finance data
FormatVerified public records, structured for independent verification
Sitedetroit.primals.eco

The same evidence package. Multiple institutions. Measure the output.

The Data

Checkpoint Response Table

This table is updated as responses arrive. Each row documents the institutional output for the same evidentiary input.

#InstitutionDepartmentFiledResponseDaysResult
1Michigan Dept. of EducationEducator Excellence20222022–Cleared with conditions
2Detroit Public Schools CDBoard of DirectorsJul 2025Jul 2025–Authorized second school
3State Bar of MichiganUPL Dept. (File 26-UP-51)Aug 2026Sep 30, 2026~30Administratively closed
4State Bar of MichiganUPL (2nd complaint)Sep 2026–PendingAwaiting response
5Baker CollegeHuman ResourcesOct 2026Oct 5, 2026<2Permanently severed
6Attorney Grievance CommissionProfessional discipline (x7)Sep-Oct 2026–PendingInvestigations pending
7Judicial Tenure CommissionJudicial conductSep 2026Sep 2026~5Investigations opened
8Central Michigan UniversityCharter authorizationPending––Notification staged
9MDE (Round 2)Credential re-examinationPending––Notification staged
10Detroit Inspector GeneralMunicipal oversightPending––Complaint staged

Key Observations

The only institution that acted in under 48 hours was a private employer with no regulatory obligation.

Baker College reviewed the same evidence that Michigan’s credentialing body, authorizing district, and professional bar department reviewed. Baker permanently severed ties. The regulatory bodies either cleared him, authorized him, or closed the complaint.

The UPL Department’s stated reason for closure: “Does not meet the standards set by the Unauthorized Practice of Law Committee to pursue this matter further.” The subject uses “J.D.” in professional communications, holds no bar admission in any jurisdiction, and operates a school named “School for Law and Public Service.”

The UPL Department’s stated alternative: “You may have other remedies available to you.”

The UPL complaint was the first of several submitted as the scope of the unauthorized credential use became clear through the investigation. Additional complaints remain pending and will be updated here as responses arrive.

The Asymmetry

Michigan’s system demands active defense from individuals:

  • A parent must file a motion and appear at a hearing to see their own children
  • A citizen must file an affirmative defense within 14 days to contest a personal protection order
  • A pro se litigant must meet the same procedural standards as a licensed attorney
  • A victim of assault must obtain and serve their own police report
  • A custody case requires the responding parent to affirmatively request the investigation the filing parent opted out of

But when a citizen uses the system’s own accountability tools:

  • A UPL complaint against a 9-time convicted felon using “J.D.” is closed as not meeting standards
  • An administrator certification for a habitual offender is granted with conditions
  • A second charter school is authorized for an operator whose first school ranks in the bottom 3% statewide
  • A police report filed at the scene of an assault requires the victim to drive to the precinct to retrieve it

The system enforces process against citizens aggressively. It declines to enforce against its own members passively.

This asymmetry is not incidental. It is the localization.

When the disorder in the lattice extends from the courts into the oversight bodies, the accountability signal has nowhere to propagate. Every checkpoint absorbs it. The individual is left with “other remedies available to you,” which means: the system has told you it will not help.

The Measurement Continues

This page is a living document. As institutional responses arrive, the table updates. Each response or non-response is a data point in the same experiment.

The question is not whether any single institution failed. Institutions make judgment calls. The question is whether the pattern of non-response across multiple independent checkpoints reveals structural localization rather than individual discretion.

When the same evidence produces action from a private college in 48 hours and produces closure from a state regulatory body in 30 days, the comparison is the finding. No editorial interpretation is required.

This is Anderson Localization measured in institutional responses rather than court assignments. The physics is the same: disorder prevents propagation. The measurement is how deep the disorder goes.
